Product Features

  • Headboard with power outlets & USB ports: One of the most practical features is the built-in power outlet at the head of the bed, which allows you to charge your phone and tablet before bed. Each socket has two EU standard charging ports and two USB ports.
  • LED lighting: LED lighting adds modern style to your bedroom, with remote control you can change the different colors and brightness for comfortable lying.
  • Storage design: The single bed is equipped with two drawers that you can attach to the left or right depending on the layout of the room. Bedspreads and duvet covers can easily be stored here.The shelf on the headboard of the bed can be used for everyday items or family picture frames.
  • Practicality meets design: Bed skilfully combines elegant design and maximum comfort. Decorative decorative knobs refine the headboard and give it a modern touch.The frame of the bed is mainly made of iron, is durable and has a load capacity of up to 300 LBS. The additional support legs of the center bar can ensure the reliable stability of the bed.
  • Detailed Information: To reduce the risk of damage, this bed frame will be shipped in 2 boxes and they can arrive on different days. If both packages arrived but parts are missing, please contact customer service.When you move the bed, please lift it instead of dragging it on the floor.
